additional_info.subject: ID0418749-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/S9 313882469001] Converter not found CRM:02679000107
additional_info.body:
Hi Daniel, good afternoon.
Please take a spare converter and CAN cables to site and do the following:
Check if the CAN cables are properly inserted in this specific converter.
If they are properly inserted:
Swap this converter with a working one (not the spare) and check the result:
If the working converter is now not working it must be the CAN cables
If the non-working converter is still not working then please replace the converter.
Let me know if you have all you need from my side.
I will send this ticket to your queue, if you need assistance just reach out to me via Teams.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
